changes.text: 海防要钱，西征也要钱。主张罢兵的人说停下来就是止损；左宗棠算的是另一笔账——有些开支，停下来一分也省不掉。

Coastal defense needed money; so did the western expedition. Those who wanted to halt it called stopping a way to cut losses. Zuo Zongtang kept a different ledger — some costs, he argued, are not saved by stopping.
崇厚得罪去，命曾纪泽使俄更前约，左宗棠自请出屯哈密，规复伊犁。六年四月，他「輿櫬發肅州」——抬着棺材从肃州出发，五月抵哈密。俄闻王师大出，增兵守伊犁、纳林河，别以兵船翔海上，用震撼京师，天津、奉天、山东皆警。七月诏左宗棠入都备顾问，由西征将领锦棠接替他；传记说俄亦慑我兵威，明年正月和议成，交还伊犁，防海军皆罢。

Chong Hou was disgraced and removed, and Zeng Jize sent to Russia to revise the treaty. Zuo asked to move out to Hami to prepare the recovery of Ili. In the fourth month of the sixth year he set out from Suzhou "carrying his coffin" and reached Hami in the fifth. Russia, hearing the imperial army was moving in force, reinforced Ili and the Naryn and put warships to sea to shake the capital; Tianjin, Fengtian and Shandong were all on alert. In the seventh month Zuo was summoned to the capital as an adviser, and Jintang, a commander of the expedition, replaced him; the biography says Russia too was cowed by our military prestige. In the first month of the following year peace was concluded, Ili returned, and the coastal forces stood down.

仗打赢之后，外部的看法也变了。国家承平久，武备弛不振，海外诸国虽见中国屡平大难，仍私议以为脆弱；及宗棠平帕夏，外国乃稍稍传说之。京师民间另有一则传言：左宗棠初入京师时，内城有教堂高楼俯瞰宫殿，民间讙言「左侯至，樓即毀矣」；后出示谕晓，传言乃止，原文未明言示谕者是谁。传记以「其威望在人如此」收束此事，随即转笔：左宗棠在军机、译署任上（此职系入觐后所授，传记记于前文），「同列頗厭苦之」，他本人也「自不樂居內，引疾乞退」。

After the victories, opinion abroad shifted. The empire had been at peace so long that its armaments had gone slack, and the overseas powers, talking of wealth and strength among themselves, still whispered that China was frail even after it had put down one great crisis after another. Once Zuo had dealt with Pasha, the foreigners began to spread the word about him. Within the capital there was a separate, domestic rumor: when Zuo first entered the capital, a church tower in the Inner City overlooked the palace, and people in the city said the tower would come down once the Marquis Zuo arrived; a notice was posted to explain, and the talk stopped. The record does not say who issued the notice. The biography closes the episode by calling it a measure of his prestige, then turns: in his posts at the Grand Council and the foreign-affairs office (conferred after his audience, as the biography records earlier), his colleagues found him a great trial, and Zuo himself, unhappy serving in the capital, pleaded illness and asked to retire.

dispositions.rationale: 英文副题改为 "some costs, he argued, are not saved by stopping"，语义通顺，并与中文“停下来一分也省不掉”一致。中文不变。

evidence.quote: 防邊兵不可減，糜餉自若

dispositions.rationale: 本段叙述中的“宗棠”统一为“左宗棠”。接替一句改为“七月诏左宗棠入都备顾问，由西征将领锦棠接替他”，写明是锦棠接替左宗棠。英文同步注明 Jintang 是西征将领，并由他接替 Zuo。

evidence.quote: 詔宗棠入都備顧問，以錦棠代之

dispositions.rationale: 原稿把授职写在“随即转笔”之后，与传记次序不符。现改为：转笔紧接的是“同列頗厭苦之”。军机大臣、兼值译署之职用括注说明系入觐后所授，传记记在前文。英文同步修改。

evidence.quote: 其威望在人如此。然值軍機、譯署，同列頗厭苦之
既入覲，賜紫禁城騎馬，使內侍二人扶掖上殿，授軍機大臣，兼值譯署
